# Wholesome Girlies

> Free tools and research-backed guidance for women, at every stage: fertility, pregnancy, postpartum, parenting, and the relationships around them. Built for African women, at home and in the diaspora. Everything is educational, never medical care, and always points to a doctor when something needs real attention.

Wholesome Girlies is a women's health and life brand. Free interactive tools and plain-language guides bring women in; one-time programs give the deeper roadmap for each stage. Content is written in a warm, plain, honest voice and follows a strict educational-not-medical policy: no diagnosis, no treatment claims, and clear routes to real care. The brand speaks as a community of women ("we"), not as invented individuals, and does not present fabricated people as real named contributors or clinicians.

## Stages

- [Relationships](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/relationships/): dating with intention and moving toward marriage
- [Fertility](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/fertility/): trying to conceive, cycles, and preparing the body
- [Pregnancy](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/pregnancy/): week-by-week, what is normal, and when to seek care
- [Postpartum](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/postpartum/): recovery for the mother, body, marriage, and mind
- [Parenting](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/parenting/): the baby years, what is normal, and keeping baby safe

## Programs (one-time, keep forever)

- [The Wife Material Blueprint](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/wife-material-blueprint): from talking stage to marriage, without games
- [The Trying-to-Conceive Blueprint](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/trying-to-conceive-blueprint): a calm, evidence-based plan for trying to conceive a first baby
- [The First Pregnancy Plan](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/first-pregnancy-plan): a week-by-week plan for a first pregnancy
- [The 6-Week Postpartum Reset](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/postpartum-reset): recovery for the mother, body, marriage, and mind
- [The First Baby Playbook](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/first-baby-playbook): a month-by-month playbook for the baby years
- [The Complete Motherhood Journey](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/programs/complete-motherhood-journey): the four motherhood programs in one bundle
- [Pricing](https://wholesomegirlies.xyz/pricing.md): all program prices
